theorems.name: Submission.wm_smoothed_scale_integral_continuousOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (c σ ρ R : ℝ), 0 < σ → 0 < c → c * ρ < R → IntegrableOn g (closedBall ξ R) μ → Continuous ψ → (∀ t, c < t → ψ t = 0) → ContinuousOn (fun τ ↦ ∫ x, g x * ψ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) ∂μ) (Icc σ ρ)
